[[Supervisor/Legends|Supervisor]] '''Mehlohtt''' was an [[Imperial Mining, Ltd.]] executive. He was in charge of the IML [[MFB-4 Mobile Repulsor Base]] deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]]. Mehlohtt had a fondness for stylish [[Suit/Legends|suits]].
